# TASK-150 — specification

## Scope

`pnpm nim:check`: live check of the NVIDIA endpoint (model list, one streamed reply, one tool call) with `NVIDIA_API_KEY` or a self-hosted `NIM_BASE_URL`, so the connection can be verified with a real key.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `pnpm nim:check` mirrors `pnpm ollama:check`: lists models, streams one reply and checks one tool call against the real endpoint.
- [ ] It needs a key, so it is the only live verification path and is reported as not run unless someone runs it.

## Verification

- Not recorded in the plan notes.

## Notes

Script written and exercised against a fake server (no key, bad address, success, no tool support). Stays open until someone runs it with a real key.
